title: Set up work email on a new phone
symptom: User has a new phone and wants her work email on it
user_description: I got a new phone. How do I get my work email onto it?

options.text: Forward her work email to her personal account
options.why: Sends company mail outside company control, which is a security and policy problem.

options.text: Use a third-party app to copy settings from her old phone
options.why: May copy the wrong or insecure settings and bypass company controls.

options.text: Follow the company process: install the approved mail app, sign in with her own account, complete MFA and accept the required device security
options.why: Using the approved app and process keeps company data protected on the phone, for example by requiring a screen lock.

options.text: Give her a shared password to use on the new phone
options.why: Shared passwords destroy accountability. She should only use her own account.

hints: Which app does the company approve for work mail?
Should the phone have any security requirements?
real_world_tip: Ask whether the old phone has been wiped or handed in. Old company phones should not keep access.
